templates.title: Excel to database
templates.description: Load rows from an .xlsx file in your workspace into a SQLite table. Renames the 'first_name' column to 'name' on the way through; remove or extend the map_rows node to match your own schema.

templates.title: Webhook to Slack notification
templates.description: Catches an incoming HTTP POST and posts the body as a message to a Slack channel. Useful for piping alerts from external systems (monitoring, build CI, Stripe events) into your team chat.

templates.title: Daily Postgres → Slack digest
templates.description: Runs a SELECT every morning, formats the result with a CEL expression, and posts the summary line to Slack. Wire your own SQL + channel; the rest stays.

templates.title: New Gmail → log to Sheet
templates.description: Polls Gmail every 5 minutes for new messages matching your query and appends them to a Google Sheet. The classic 'archive incoming form/invoice emails for later'.

templates.title: Sheet → Postgres sync
templates.description: Reads a Google Sheet on a schedule, upserts every row into a Postgres table (so re-runs don't create duplicates). Perfect for ops teams maintaining a master list in Sheets that downstream services consume from the DB.

templates.title: New Gmail → Slack (dedupe)
templates.description: Poll Gmail every 5 minutes; new messages since the last fire trigger a Slack post. The cursor is persisted via secret_set so dedupe survives daemon restarts — exercises the cursor-based polling pattern end-to-end.

templates.title: GitHub issue webhook → Slack
templates.description: Receive a GitHub issue webhook, format the payload into one Slack line, post to your triage channel. Configure the repo's webhook URL to the flow's /trigger endpoint and you're routing.

templates.title: Sheet × DB join → upsert
templates.description: Hourly: read a Google Sheet, left-join each row against a Postgres lookup table, upsert the enriched result back to Postgres. Shows join_rows in a real ETL position.

templates.title: Daily group-by report → Slack
templates.description: Every morning, query yesterday's orders, group by country with sum/avg/count, render a per-country summary line, post to Slack. Exercises group_aggregate composed with compute_rows.

templates.title: Webhook → Postgres event log
templates.description: Receive a JSON webhook POST and insert it as a row in an events table. Use case: collect Stripe / GitHub / internal-service events into one analytics table without writing a custom collector.

templates.title: Clean Excel → email summary
templates.description: Read an .xlsx, rename + drop columns, filter incomplete rows, aggregate totals, email the summary line via Gmail. Pipeline pattern with a non-Slack outbound.

templates.title: New Notion row → Slack (dedupe)
templates.description: Poll a Notion database every 5 minutes; new rows since last fire post to Slack. Cursor persisted via secret_set so dedupe survives daemon restarts. Same cursor pattern Gmail uses.

templates.title: Mirror Notion DB → Postgres
templates.description: Hourly upsert every Notion page from a database into a Postgres table. Lets you run analytics queries Notion's API can't easily serve.

templates.title: Slack mention → GitHub issue
templates.description: When @-mentioned in Slack, create a GitHub issue with the mention text. Routes 'hey can someone look at X' into a tracked queue instead of chat scrollback.

templates.title: Push to main → Slack deploy alert
templates.description: Listen to GitHub push webhooks; commits to main post a Slack alert. Branch filtered downstream so feature-branch pushes stay quiet. Foundation for a deploy-bot pattern.
